welcome.title: Name this machine
welcome.desc: These can be set in Settings → About later

start.title: Build or import your array
start.desc: For now, one parity and one data disk. Add more after later. If you have a previous array from NonRAID or Unraid, you can import the superblock.
start.buildChoiceDesc: Assign a parity disk and your data disks now.
start.importChoiceDesc: From a previous NonRAID or Unraid install.
start.restoreChoiceDesc: Bring back everything from a previous NonRAID WebUI install with a config backup.

restoreConfig.title: Restore a full config backup
restoreConfig.desc: Bring back everything from a previous NonRAID WebUI install with a config backup. Pick where the backup is coming from.

disks.title: Build your array
disks.desc: Pick a parity disk and a data disk, then press Build Array. Initialization - clearing the data disk and building parity. Continues in the background. Once it's finished building, add more disks, a second parity disk, or a cache mirror from the Disks page.

apps.title: Install ready-made apps
apps.body: The Apps catalog has one-click installs for common self-hosted services - media servers, downloaders, home automation, and more.

docker.title: Or run your own containers
docker.body: Setup a custome Docker container with ports/volumes/env vars, and shows a live log.

lxc.title: Or a full lightweight VM
lxc.body: LXC gives you a more complete lightweight VM instead.

notifications.title: Get important notifications through 150+ services!
notifications.body: Turn on notifications in Settings and setup Apprise to be notified by email, Discord, ntfy, or many more. When a disk fails, a parity check finishes, or something needs your attention.

backups.title: Don't lose this setup twice
backups.body: Back up NonRAID WebUI config locally or to 70+ providers via rclone. Settings → Backups sets it up; Settings → Recovery brings it back.

done.title: You're all set
done.desc: Head to the Dashboard to check on the array, or Disks to keep adding storage. You can replay this tour any time from Settings → About.

RemoteRestoreOnboarding.rcloneNotInstalled: The rclone package isn't installed on this host - re-run tools/install-webui.sh on it to enable remote backups.
RemoteRestoreOnboarding.titleRecoverArray: Recover the array from a remote backup
RemoteRestoreOnboarding.pickRemoteDesc: Pick an already added remote provider or connect a new one.
